notes.title: v[0.07] Color Customization: Checkouts
notes.content:
Color Customization: Cash Registers and Self-Checkout Machines
Now it's possible to change the color of your cash registers and self-checkout machines.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/404edf3a0d3a922198e99f0957c294cc53eb5d8a.jpg"]You can customize the cash register and self-checkout machine colors by pressing the B-key (by default) when you hover over them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/34ca9752c14b778655b5373b1a4dd8008d818324.jpg"]It's B-key by default. You can change it from the Options-Controls.

Keybinding: Options -> Controls -> Customize Color

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/1688ba3056774bb554d35b16dc74788ff35a2153.jpg"]

notes.title: v[0.05] Color Customization: Store Racks
notes.content:
Color Customization: Store Racks
Now it's possible to change the color of your store racks.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/288d17057a273f22290d680b4ee4e3cdf9c3504b.jpg"]

You can customize the store rack colors by pressing the B-key (by default) when you hover over a store rack.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/87549ef55eb8c8cda372cae16a77bc8b05d4abdf.jpg"]

It's B-key by default. You can change it from the Options-Controls.

Keybinding: Options -> Controls -> Customize Color

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/1688ba3056774bb554d35b16dc74788ff35a2153.jpg"]

Please select "Apply to the same type" if you want all the same type of store racks in the same color.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/62320eba2bc275789a9e94ad19283c722f948cdb.jpg"]

Please select "Apply to all" if you want all the store racks in the same color.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596651/ffb3f9ae7b8fa8c43dabc950f83885dc8c7d1c19.jpg"]
